title: •Vader
caption: •Vader (V)
game_text: {pilot:4}. Jedi are defense value -1 and forfeit -2 at same and related sites. During battle, if you are about to draw a card for weapon or battle destiny, may instead use an Interrupt of destiny < 4 from hand. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Sought to extinguish all Jedi. Former student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Seduced by the dark side of the Force.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Base page is 'Vader (Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game)' (the plain 'Vader' page does not exist; the stub links [[Vader]] and the V19 'Vader (V)' page's hatnote names the P2P card). Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 6 / DARK JEDI (label only); deploy 6 / forfeit 8. Yellow DS pilot-power icon followed by '4.' at the start → {pilot:4} (stub expands 'Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots'). Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior (printed card has warrior only). Imperial (Imperial disc top-left). Lore matches the scan. The printed P2P card has NO expansion-set ring beside the lore box (checked on the scan). Copyright reads 1995 on the scan (Premiere art reused), read at zoom. Base scan only at 350 px. Modern: V19-D-vader.gif (745 px) is the later Virtual Set 19 'Vader (V)' — a different text but the same art and lore; VB1-D-vader-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 1 reissue of this slip) also downloaded to modern/.
